title: Monster Bullets
description:
A VARIETY OF BULLETS

In Monster Bullets each monster type has a unique weakness. Become a gun slinging monster hunter and master the art of reading a situation and loading the right bullet for each monster.GONZO MONSTERS

From radio entities that get inside your head to space spiders with hallucinogenic venom, encounter a wide range of creative and novel monsters. Complete your bestiary and uncover strategies and lore.FEATURES
• Multiplayer Coop
Monster Bullets is built and balanced with single-player in mind but that doesn't mean you can't play with up to 5 friends!

• Procedural Maps
Navigate catacombs, forests, caves, and more in Monster Bullets. All layouts are procedurally generated to ensure that each run is different from the last!

• Speed Running Timer
Compete with your friends to see who can delve into the dungeon depths and slay the goblin king the fastest!

• Endless Mode
After slaying the goblin king, you can test your endurance and see how long you can make it in endless mode!

• Gonzo Monsters
Over 24 varied monsters from shapeshifting skinwalkers to lumbering trolls!

• Dynamic Upgrades
Over 24 upgrades with novel interactions for different monster archetypes.
description_short: Monster Bullets is a first-person roguelite where each monster has a specific weakness. Quickly load the correct bullet for each monster and fire them off! Experiment with upgrades on each procedurally generated attempt and try to slay the goblin king!
